versions.subject: Microsoft Malware Protection Engine Crash - ref CVE-2017-0290
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Source: 'Application Error'
    EventID: 1000 
selection2:
    Source: 'Windows Error Reporting'
    EventID: 1001
keyword1:
    - 'MsMpEng.exe'
keyword2:
    - 'mpengine.dll'
condition: selection1 or selection2 and keyword1 and 1 of keyword2
versions.spl: (Source="Application Error" EventID=1000) OR (Source="Windows Error Reporting" EventID=1001 "MsMpEng.exe" "mpengine.dll")
